name: Grilled Steak Salad with Arugula, Pecans & Orange-Dijon Dressing

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of grill pan or skillet with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, wash, zest, and juice half of the oranges into a large bowl. Cut off the skin and white pith from the remaining oranges; cut between the membranes to release the segments and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the orange juice and zest. Add vinegar, oil, honey, Dijon, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp paprika
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and thinly slice the shallots; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
Wash arugula (skip if it came pre-washed) and add to the bowl with the dressing and onions; toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with pecans, orange segments, and steak. Enjoy!
